name: Imaging and reconstructing hidden structures
gist: Using AI to recover sharp images from blurry scans or partial data, revealing internal structures in microscopy, medical imaging, and cryo-EM without expensive higher-resolution equipment.
explain: A microscope image is always fuzzy. A medical scan — CT, MRI, X-ray — is always noisy and low resolution. Cryo-EM (a technique to see proteins) produces images so grainy they look like abstract art. This is not a failure — it is the cost of using safe radiation doses or capturing fleeting biological moments. But the loss of detail costs researchers: they miss tiny features, misdiagnose diseases, or cannot see exactly where a drug binds to its target.

Traditional approaches sharpen images by assuming specific models: assume the image is a blurred version of a sharp image, then deblur it using math. But biological structures are so varied that no single mathematical model works well. Cryo-EM images of proteins are determined by how they were randomly frozen and angled in the microscope, so the same protein looks different in each image. A tumor in a scan has texture and shape that varies from person to person.

This cluster uses neural networks to learn what sharp biological images look like by training on pairs: start with high-quality reference data (expensive, rare) and lower-quality versions (the actual scans we want to improve), and train a network to map from fuzzy to sharp. The challenge is generalizing: images from one microscope are different from another, data from one disease looks different from another. So papers here explore transfer learning (train once on a reference dataset, adapt quickly to new data), uncertainty quantification (the network should admit when it is guessing), and physics-informed networks (build in what we know about how imaging works). The payoff is microscopy and medical imaging that is clearer and cheaper because doctors can see tiny features without higher-end hardware, speeding up diagnosis and discovery because clearer images reveal disease earlier.

papers.title: ADHD Disease Detection Based on Short- and Long-Term Brain Function Encoding and Memory Graph Network
papers.contribution: Superior performance on ADHD-200 and OpenNeuro-ds002424 neuroimaging datasets for brain disorder detection.

papers.title: Assembling the Mind's Mosaic: Towards EEG Semantic Intent Decoding
papers.contribution: Enables interpretable and expressive BCI-mediated communication; demonstrates substantial advantages over existing frameworks on multilingual EEG and clinical SEEG datasets.

papers.title: CryoNet.Refine: A One-step Diffusion Model for Rapid Refinement of Structural Models with Cryo-EM Density Map Restraints
papers.contribution: Consistently yields substantial improvements in model-map correlation and geometric quality over Phenix.real_space_refine, applicable to proteins, nucleic acids, and assemblies.

papers.title: Eigen-1: Scientific Reasoning through Adaptive Multi-Agent Refinement and Monitor-based RAG
papers.contribution: Achieves 48.3% accuracy on Humanity's Last Exam Bio/Chem Gold, surpassing strongest baselines by 13.4 points, while reducing token usage by 53.5% and agent steps by 43.7%.

papers.title: Evidential Reasoning Advances Interpretable Real-World Disease Screening
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance on disease screening benchmarks with enhanced interpretability through regional evidence retrieval and abnormality mapping.

papers.title: MindPilot: Closed-loop Visual Stimulation Optimization for Brain Modulation with EEG-guided Diffusion
papers.contribution: MindPilot enables efficient semantic target retrieval, closed-loop EEG feature optimization, and human-subject validation in mental matching and emotion regulation tasks.

papers.title: Optimal transport unlocks end-to-end learning for single-molecule localization
papers.contribution: Surpasses state-of-the-art at moderate and high emitter densities on synthetic and real biological data.

papers.title: PETRI: Learning Unified Cell Embeddings from Unpaired Modalities via Early-Fusion Joint Reconstruction
papers.contribution: Supports perturbation-level profiles via simple averaging and sparse autoencoder analysis reveals learned concepts that are biologically meaningful and preserve perturbation effects.

papers.title: AutoMat: Physics-Guided Agentic Reasoning for Solving Ill-Posed Inverse Microscopy Problems
papers.contribution: Outperforms SOTA models on STEM2Mat-Bench with 450+ annotated samples across lattice RMSD, formation energy MAE, and structure matching.

papers.title: Benchmarking ECG Foundational Models: A Reality Check Across Clinical Tasks
papers.contribution: ECG-CPC, a compact structured state-space model, dominated 5 of 7 task categories despite being orders of magnitude smaller, challenging scale assumptions.

papers.title: Beyond Instance-Level Self-Supervision in 3D Multi-Modal Medical Imaging
papers.contribution: Average improvements of 1.1% in segmentation and 5.94% in classification tasks, with better robustness when modalities are missing at test time.

papers.title: Brain-IT: Image Reconstruction from fMRI via Brain-Interaction Transformer
papers.contribution: Brain-IT achieves image reconstructions that faithfully reconstruct seen images and surpass current methods both visually and on objective metrics, with strong few-shot generalization.

papers.title: CRONOS: Continuous time reconstruction for 4D medical longitudinal series
papers.contribution: CRONOS is the first to achieve continuous sequence-to-image forecasting for 3D medical data, outperforming baselines across Cine-MRI, perfusion CT, and longitudinal MRI datasets.

papers.title: CryoACE: An Atom-centric Framework for Accurate and Automated Model Building in Cryo-EM
papers.contribution: The method outperforms baselines on static benchmarks and for the first time unveils atomic-level dynamic conformations on complex real-world datasets.

papers.title: CryoLVM: Self-supervised Learning from Cryo-EM Density Maps with Large Vision Models
papers.contribution: CryoLVM consistently outperforms baselines on density map sharpening, super-resolution, and missing wedge restoration, demonstrating effectiveness as a versatile model for cryo-EM applications.

papers.title: CryoSplat: Gaussian Splatting for Cryo-EM Homogeneous Reconstruction
papers.contribution: Enables stable and efficient homogeneous reconstruction directly from raw cryo-EM particles without external initialization.

papers.title: Decoding Open-Ended Information Seeking Goals from Eye Movements in Reading
papers.contribution: Demonstrates considerable success in goal selection among options and progress toward free-form textual goal reconstruction, opening new avenues for goal-driven reading research.

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion with Physical Mass Constraints for \emph{De Novo} Peptide Sequencing
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance exceeding baselines by over 2% in precision, with larger gains on out-of-distribution data.

papers.title: EpiTwin: Spatiotemporal Graph Transformers for Epileptic sEEG Signal Reconstruction
papers.contribution: EpiTwin achieves 16.8% relative reduction in RMSE compared to foundation models like LaBraM, effectively mitigates spectral over-smoothing, and improves reconstruction fidelity on real-world clinical sEEG data.

papers.title: Foundation VAE for CT Reconstruction, Augmentation, and Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves 3.9% NSD improvement for segmentation on reconstructions and 3.9% lower FVD with 36.2% higher CT CLIP score for generation.

papers.title: Geometrically Constrained Stenosis Editing in Coronary Angiography via Entropic Optimal Transport
papers.contribution: Synthesized angiograms improve downstream stenosis detection by 27.8% on ARCADE and 23.0% on multi-center data.

papers.title: Glance and Focus Reinforcement for Pan-cancer Screening
papers.contribution: GF-Screen effectively extends RL techniques to pan-cancer screening for the first time, improving efficiency and reducing false positives through glance-and-focus strategy.

papers.title: Hierarchical Multi-Scale Molecular Conformer Generation with Structural Awareness
papers.contribution: Generates more stable and chemically plausible molecular conformers that integrate seamlessly with existing generative models.

papers.title: LASER: Learning Active Sensing for Continuum Field Reconstruction
papers.contribution: The closed-loop framework consistently outperforms static and offline-optimized strategies, achieving high-fidelity reconstruction across diverse continuum fields.

papers.title: Med-Scout: Curing MLLMs' Geometric Blindness in Medical Perception via Geometry-Aware RL Post-Training
papers.contribution: Med-Scout mitigates geometric blindness, outperforming leading MLLMs by over 40% on the Med-Scout-Bench benchmark and generalizing to broader medical understanding.

papers.title: MolAlign3D: Enhancing Fixed-Dimensional E(3)-Equivariant Latent Space for High-Fidelity 3D Molecular Reconstruction and Editing
papers.contribution: Achieves high-fidelity reconstruction and comparable property prediction; significantly enhances zero-shot molecular manipulation including atom-count editing.

papers.title: Moving Beyond Diffusion: Hierarchy-to-Hierarchy Autoregression for fMRI-to-Image Reconstruction
papers.contribution: MindHier achieves superior semantic fidelity, 4.67x faster inference, and more deterministic results than diffusion baselines via hierarchical reconstruction mimicking human perception.

papers.title: NAB: Neural Adaptive Binning for Sparse-View CT reconstruction
papers.contribution: NAB achieves superior performance on datasets by integrating rectangular priors and generalizing to complex geometries via adjustable smoothness.

papers.title: PCRNet: Phase-aware Complex Refinement Network for EEG-based Auditory Attention Decoding
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three public datasets, particularly under challenging ultra-short 0.1-second windows, via effective phase recalibration and enhanced feature discriminability.

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Diffusion Meets ADMM: Dual-Variable Coupling for Robust Medical Image Reconstruction
papers.contribution: Resolves bias-hallucination trade-off achieving state-of-the-art fidelity with significantly accelerated convergence on CT and MRI reconstruction.

papers.title: Principled Confidence Estimation for Deep Computed Tomography
papers.contribution: Deep reconstruction methods yield substantially tighter confidence regions than classical methods while maintaining theoretical coverage guarantees and enable hallucination detection.

papers.title: ProConMV: Provenance-Enabled Conceptual Framework for Interpretable Multi-View Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis
papers.contribution: Reduces generalization error upper bound via uncertainty incorporation; demonstrates effectiveness on two public multi-view DR datasets with verifiable analysis.

papers.title: QuantWear: Quantum-scale Wear Particle Detection for Jet Engine Diagnosis
papers.contribution: Achieves 22.5 dB imaging SNR and 95% 3D reconstruction similarity, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art wear particle detection technologies.

papers.title: Recover Cell Tensor: Diffusion-Equivalent Tensor Completion for Fluorescence Microscopy Imaging
papers.contribution: Demonstrates state-of-the-art on SR-CACO-2 and four real in vivo cellular datasets with substantial improvements in signal-to-noise ratio and structural fidelity.

papers.title: Reference-Free Meta-Learning for Generalized Implicit Neural Representation in Efficient MRI Reconstruction
papers.contribution: IPOD eliminates dependence on reference images and enables rapid adaptation achieving high-fidelity MRI reconstruction across imaging protocols.

papers.title: Refine Now, Query Fast: A Decoupled Refinement Paradigm for Implicit Neural Fields
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art fidelity up to 27× faster inference than baselines via decoupled refinement and novel Variational Pairs data augmentation.

papers.title: Regulating Anatomy-Aware Rewards via Trajectory-Integral Feedback for Volumetric Computed Tomography Analysis
papers.contribution: Significantly enhances abnormality detection and clinical faithfulness on 3D CT benchmarks by penalizing persistent omissions as cumulative state errors.

papers.title: STRIDE: Post-Training LLMs to Reason and Refine Bio-Sequences via Edit Trajectories
papers.contribution: Raises protein stress test success from 42% to 89% and improves novelty from 47% to 97%, with superior performance on instruction-conditioned molecular editing.

papers.title: Structured Multi-modal Graph Disentanglement for Psychiatric Diagnosis
papers.contribution: SMGD improves in-domain diagnosis and cross-dataset generalization under modality gaps on large multi-site datasets without relying on expert-crafted diagnostic biomarkers.

papers.title: SubDyve: Subgraph-Driven Dynamic Propagation for Virtual Screening Enhancement Controlling False Positive
papers.contribution: SubDyve consistently outperforms fingerprint and embedding-based approaches, achieving margins up to +34.0 on BEDROC and +24.6 on EF_1% metric across DUD-E targets.

papers.title: Transforming Weather Data from Pixel to Latent Space
papers.contribution: Compresses ERA5 full PVS from 244.34 TB to 0.43 TB while achieving superior performance on downstream weather tasks compared to pixel-space models.

papers.title: TumorChain: Interleaved Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Traceable Clinical Tumor Analysis
papers.contribution: Demonstrates consistent gains in lesion detection, impression quality, and pathology classification through multimodal interleaved causal reasoning with improved traceability.
